integrity.proof_scope: All real alpha>1 and theta>0, all thinning t in (0,1), all integer positive jump sizes

scientific_limitations: The self-decomposability notion is that of independent Bernoulli thinning of nonnegative integer counts, not real-line self-decomposability.
An all-thinning invariant marginal does not imply that its independent innovations belong to the original PGL family.
Historical priority is provisional; one relevant 2023 paper was available only as an abstract and later full technical reproduction.
The overlapping WNBL counterexample concerns one stated rational member and does not assess all properties of that distinct family.
title: Sharp thinning self-decomposability frontier of the two-parameter Poisson generalized Lindley law
